answer: Sparrow-beacon ridge delay bond: each identity clears a verifiable delay puzzle from the beacon and files proof on the ridge. The beacon seeds each epoch; each runs a sequential delay on its own key. Auditors replay each proof; forgery, reuse, or a rented-delay ring burns the 70-credit bond. The k-th delay costs 38+6(k-1); a thousand fakes burn 3,035,000 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 prize. An honest sparrow pays 38 once and reclaims its bond.
